crossRefs.note: In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.
I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman…
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to…
Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied…
Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…

translations.web: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
translations.bsb: Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
translations.kjv: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
translations.asv: Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, That walketh in his ways.
